simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֶּן־עַמִּי (H1151) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: בֶּן־עַמִּי (Ben-ʻAmmîy) means Ben-Ammi , a son of Lot First listed occurrence: Gen 19 38.

definitions.full: H1151. Ben -ammi בֶּןעַֿמִּי proper name, masculine ( son of my people ) son of Lot by his younger daughter, and ancestor of the Ammonites ( בְּנֵיעַֿמּוֺן see עַמּוֺן ) Gen 19:38 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1121 and 5971 with pronomial suffix; son of my people;
